name: medical-journal-selector
description: Evidence-backed medical journal selection with three simultaneous submission strategies.

interface.shortDescription: 医学选刊：高分区、时间、适配三条路线，逐项核验来源。
interface.longDescription: Read a medical manuscript, check current journal policies and metrics, and compare three submission strategies with explicit missing evidence.
interface.defaultPrompt: Read my manuscript and recommend journals by JCR quartile, publication time, and methodological fit. Verify current facts and mark anything unverified.
